inputs: canonical cohorts, institutions, assets and directed ownership/access
scope and dated finite response-slot accounts
ordinary, preparedness, response and external-aid claims
hazard/exposure provenance, vulnerability knowledge, authority, disclosure and aid conditions
procedure: Validate canonical identities, unique asset/account mappings, scope, period and units. Separate physical, institutional, access and disclosure findings. Unknown prerequisites and obligation conflicts withhold new allocations. Stage finite commitments through the shared allocator, preserving holds and prior postings. External aid requires finite declared capacity and satisfied conditions.
independent_oracle: Enumerate feasible integer allocations for supply zero through four and two demands one through three under priority and all-or-nothing. A two-slot preparedness hold against three slots leaves one ordinary slot and is consumed once.
limits: No integrated staff, materials or actual rescue
No hazard probability, damage or security score
No transitions, activation, numerical IPC or parent acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
